text: The purpose of this report is to recommend amendments to the Rules of Procedure for the Sign Variance Committee to allow for electronic hearings.

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Enacted By-law No. 4 in revised Attachment 1 to the supplementary report (August 4, 2020) from the City Clerk, being a by-law to amend Sign Variance Committee By-law No. 1. 2. Adopted the electronic hearing requirements and operational guidelines in Attachment 2 to the report (July 28, 2020) from the City Clerk.
